Still the fur-for-iron trade exists with the Wildlings and Slavers exists, so it's not unthinkable that they got some decent iron off of a few traders. That being said, yeah Valyrian Steel is pretty resilient.

There will always be some ragers, but I guess they're part of the diversity of the community, and deserve their place.

I really enjoyed the past days with a lot of activity, and little to no downvoats.

Upvoates suffice to separate good posts from bad posts. Downvoates are only used to express disagreement. And that ist not their purpose at all.

I think removing downvoats would be a good thing, however sometimes it feels so satisfying to downvoat a troll...

Downvotes should be allowed because dislike is a valid response. I hate having my hands tied on Facebook where "likes" are the only button.
